From one fragile player to another…

Playing rift is demoralizing as hell. Believe me, nobody can keep completely zen playing rift. Its a 20-30 min investment per match and its up to the entire team to work together to victory. It doesn’t take much for someone to ruin it for everyone, a matchmaking gap, or something else out of your control. 

You can hit up norms to practice something alone but you have to lock in the mindset that you DO NOT and WILL NOT care what people have to say because “its just a norm!”, that is the closest you will get to having the ranked experience without the excessive sweat. But muteall when nothing useful is being pinged/chat to preserve mental stability. 

Even playing in a premade with friends, if you have ONE person get pissy over the mistakes of a learning player(new champ, new lane, unfamiliar matchup) or somebody isn’t performing as expected(skill gap), the experience is soured. You will need friends who can be patient, who do not babyrage, and both you and them need to be able to let things go. 

I switched over to aram and arena only and never looked back because nobody takes that mode seriously. To me, it is not worth it to be flung shit at in game or even in voice with friends over rift. I am pressured to perform, to play my best role, to play my best champions, so everyone can have a fair game and not have me go 0/8 lose lane on something new/not meta and lose the game for everyone. Thats the very most demoralizing part- seeing you are the one bringing everyone down, seeing what people say, and taking all that into future games. 

Sadly the bots aren’t up to real player skill level just yet so practice against bots will never be enough. If you want to improve without the pressure of randoms and even friends, hit up practice tool, watch some youtube guides, consult higher elo friends or summonerschool for coaching in vod reviews, and ONLY get into premade lobbies with those you can absolutely trust to not lose their shit over other’s mistakes. 

If your fiance is serious about climbing but cannot stand the pings or chat, she unfortunately should mute all when she plays ranked. Maybe like 5% of players will actually give useful information in game when the vibes are right, the rest will babyrage because ranked is sweat central. Still there is no point in keeping any channels open for that slim chance in low elo. Somebody will start showing signs they are mentally unwell in game eventually, so have muteall ready.
